judged_text: The handler uses schema.parse (which throws ZodError) plus unguarded symmetricDecrypt/JSON.parse and has no HTTP method check, so malformed or GET requests surface as unhandled 500s. adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, there is no HTTP method guard (so GET/other methods reach `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)`), and both `zod.parse(...)` and the subsequent `symmetricDecrypt(...)` + `JSON.parse(...)` are unguarded. Any malformed body (e.g., missing/invalid types like string `userId`), invalid ciphertext, or bad/empty encryption key will throw and surface as an unhandled 500 rather than a controlled 4xx response. This behavior is directly visible in the handler implementation and matches the finding’s claim about opaque 500s for slightly wrong payloads.
